_doc: Every enemy and boss. body: 'chibi' (look = a Chibi 2.6 avatar) or 'creature' (look = an avatar-3d creature spec). ai = the brain in js/sim/foes.js. moves use the same fields as hero moves (data/classes.json), plus cd (s between uses), w (weight when picking), range [min,max] (m along the road it likes to use it from), phase (boss phase it unlocks at, 0-based), summon. poise: hits of this much damage before it flinches (0 = flinches from everything). shield: 'front' blocks light frontal hits. heavy: can't be grabbed or thrown. xp / gold on defeat. height in metres (drawn size = rule size). down = how it takes knockdowns (js/sim/brawl.js downAllowed / getUp): resist = knockdowns it soaks before it falls (Heavy, throws and Breaker count 2), refill = s until that meter is full again, stand = knocked back but stays on its feet while the meter holds (always, with no meter), getUp = time on the floor × the usual, guard = s its guard is raised after getting up (frontal blows bounce), counter = the move it swings on getting up, limit + window = at most this many knockdowns in that many seconds (bosses). A shot with pull is a thrown hook: it drags the hero it hits to the thrower; jumping higher than pull.over, dashing or blocking beats it. Acts II/III: rise (s climbing out of the ground or fading in; can't be hit until up; riseHow ground|fade), swoop (a flyer dives to hit), selfDestruct (the burst is its last act), shot/aoe leave = a lasting burning patch { r, time, dmg, look }, aoe shape 'row' (along the street, len) / cols (strips across the street: n, w, gap, delay, step), gust (pushes every hero along the street), backEdge (too big for the road: lives behind the back edge at z = home and is hidden until a move's expose { part, time, delay } brings a part down onto the road), hazards (warned zones the boss keeps dropping, by phase), calmAt (the fight ends when she drops to that share — no kill), partner / pairOf (two bosses, one shared phase pool and the lead's lines), phases with two thresholds = three phases (lines.phase, lines.phase2), skyOnPhase (Ossmara strikes when that phase starts), summonOnPhase, gap (s between a big body's moves), render = hints for the renderer (big body kind, ghost, glass, veins, tint).
